newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fletcher says Asian talks not final.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fletcher says Asian talks not final.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Ltd said on Wednesday said it was in negotiations which could lead to the sale by its construction unit of some Asian assets but rejected a statement by OLS Asia Holdings Ltd that a deal had already been struck.

"This is to advise that Fletcher Challenge has not entered into a transaction of the type described in the news release from OLS Asia Holdings Ltd," Fletcher told the Australian Stock Exchange. The statement was sent from Fletcher's head office in Auckland, New Zealand, and a spokesman was not available for further comment.

"Negotiations have been undertaken which could result in the sale by Fletcher Challenge Construction of a licence to undertake public construction projects in Hong Kong and three non-operating companies," Fletcher said. "These negotiations do not envisage the transfer of any Fletcher Challenge Construction offices, personnel, construction projects or the Fletcher Challenge Construction name," the company said.

OLS earlier told the stock exchange that it had acquired Fletcher Challenge Construction's Asian interests and its regional manager Graham Duff and other executives would join the firm. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
